name: Southwest Ridge
descent_text: Descend the way you came. From the summit, work back along the ramps and ledges on the southeast side to the false summit, then downclimb the class 3 rock of the southwest ridge to the col. The step between the two summits is very exposed and a fall there would be fatal, so move carefully and avoid wet rock. From the col, retrace the traverse to the upper col and descend the gully to the Access Creek meadows, which becomes a loose rock pile late in the season, so stay close together or out of each other's fall line and wear helmets. Then bushwhack back to Big Beaver Creek, ford it, and walk the Big Beaver trail out to the Ross Lake landing.
